type.description: Transport used by the media type. Possible values: 0 - email; 1 - script; 2 - SMS; 4 - Webhook.

exec_path.description: For script media types, exec_path contains the name of the executed script. Required for script media types.

gsm_modem.description: Serial device name of the GSM modem. Required for SMS media types.

passwd.description: Authentication password. Used for email media types.

smtp_email.description: Email address from which notifications will be sent. Required for email media types.

smtp_helo.description: SMTP HELO. Required for email media types.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server. Required for email media types.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port to connect to.

smtp_security.description: SMTP connection security level to use. Possible values: 0 - None; 1 - STARTTLS; 2 - SSL/TLS.

smtp_verify_host.description: SSL verify host for SMTP. Possible values: 0 - No; 1 - Yes.

smtp_verify_peer.description: SSL verify peer for SMTP. Possible values: 0 - No; 1 - Yes.

smtp_authentication.description: SMTP authentication method to use. Possible values: 0 - None; 1 - Normal password.

status.description: Whether the media type is enabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

username.description: User name. Used for email media types.

exec_params.description: Script parameters. Each parameter ends with a new line feed.

maxsessions.description: The maximum number of alerts that can be processed in parallel. Possible values for SMS: 1 - (default). Possible values for other media types: 0-100.

maxattempts.description: The maximum number of attempts to send an alert. Possible values: 1-100. Default value: 3.

attempt_interval.description: The interval between retry attempts. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Possible values: 0-1h. Default value: 10s.

content_type.description: Message format. Possible values: 0 - plain text; 1 - (default) html.

script.description: Media type webhook script javascript body.

timeout.description: Media type webhook script timeout. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix. Possible values: 1-60s. Default value: 30s.

process_tags.description: Defines should the webhook script response to be interpreted as tags and these tags should be added to associated event. Possible values: 0 - (default) Ignore webhook script response; 1 - Process webhook script response as tags.

show_event_menu.description: Show media type entry in problem.get and event.get property urls. Possible values: 0 - (default) Do not add urls entry; 1 - Add media type to urls property.

event_menu_url.description: Define url property of media type entry in urls property of problem.get and event.get.

event_menu_name.description: Define name property of media type entry in urls property of problem.get and event.get.

parameters.description: Webhook parameters to be created for the media type.

items.description: Webhook input parameter passed to the webhook script when it is called.

message_templates.description: Message templates to be created for the media type.

items.description: Message template defining a default message for action operations to send a notification.

eventsource.description: Event source. Possible values: 0 - triggers; 1 - discovery; 2 - autoregistration; 3 - internal; 4 - services.

recovery.description: Operation mode. Possible values: 0 - operations; 1 - recovery operations; 2 - update operations.
